titleTh: ซื้อขนมปังที่ร้านเบเกอรี่
scenarioSentences: You are at a small bakery.
There are many kinds of bread.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good morning. I need some bread for a family lunch.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Russell
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want white or brown bread?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Which one is fresh today?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Russell
dialogue.text: Both are fresh. I made them at five this morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My parents like brown bread. Is it soft?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Russell
dialogue.text: Yes, it's soft inside. It's still warm too.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: We are eight people. How many loaves do I need?

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Russell
dialogue.text: Two loaves are good for eight people.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, two brown loaves, please.

dialogue.speaker: Mrs. Russell
dialogue.text: Here you are. That's six dollars.

titleTh: สมัครเรียนเต้นสำหรับมือใหม่
scenarioSentences: You want to learn to dance.
Ms. Santos is a teacher there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Ms. Santos. I want to learn to dance, but I'm a beginner.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Santos
dialogue.text: No problem! Everyone starts at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Which class is good for me?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Santos
dialogue.text: We have two beginner classes, on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I work late on Tuesdays. What time is the Thursday class?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Santos
dialogue.text: It's from seven to eight.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's perfect. Do I need special shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Santos
dialogue.text: Not for the first class. Just wear comfortable shoes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. I'll join the Thursday class this week.

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Santos
dialogue.text: Wonderful. See you on Thursday at seven!

titleEn: Flying a kite in the park
titleTh: ไปเล่นว่าวที่สวนสาธารณะ
scenarioSentences: You want to fly the kite.
Your friend Arlo is with you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Arlo, it's really windy today. Let's fly my new kite!

dialogue.speaker: Arlo
dialogue.text: Great idea! Where can we go?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What about the small park near my house?

dialogue.speaker: Arlo
dialogue.text: That park has a lot of trees. That's bad for kites.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: You're right. How about the big park on the hill?

dialogue.speaker: Arlo
dialogue.text: Yes! It's open and very windy up there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How do we get there?

dialogue.speaker: Arlo
dialogue.text: We can ride our bikes. It's only ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Let's go after lunch, at one o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Arlo
dialogue.text: Sounds good. I'll bring some water and snacks.

titleTh: ไปตกปลากับคุณปู่
scenarioSentences: You are staying with your grandparents.
He wants to take you tomorrow.
You ask him about the trip.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Grandpa, what time are we going fishing tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Grandpa
dialogue.text: Early. Let's leave at six. Fish eat in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Six? That's very early! Can we go at eight?

dialogue.speaker: Grandpa
dialogue.text: Sorry, eight is late. We won't catch anything.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, six o'clock. What do I need to bring?

dialogue.speaker: Grandpa
dialogue.text: I have everything for fishing. Just bring a hat.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A hat? Why?

dialogue.speaker: Grandpa
dialogue.text: The sun is very strong on the lake.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll get my hat ready tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Grandpa
dialogue.text: Good. I'll wake you up at half past five.

titleEn: Buying ice cream on a hot day
titleTh: ซื้อไอศกรีมกินวันอากาศร้อน
scenarioSentences: It is a very hot day.
You are walking in the park.
You see an ice cream stand.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. What flavors do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: We have chocolate, vanilla, strawberry and mango.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hmm. Is the mango one sweet?

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: Yes, it's sweet. But many people buy chocolate today.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay, chocolate, please. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: Three dollars. Do you want a cup or a cone?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: A cone, please. I love cones.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: Sure. Eat it fast, because it's very hot today!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I will! Here's three dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.text: Thanks. Here's your chocolate cone. Enjoy!

titleTh: ไปเที่ยวตลาดนัดกลางคืน
scenarioSentences: There is a night market in town.
Your friend Becky wants to go.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Becky, let's go to the night market on Friday!

dialogue.speaker: Becky
dialogue.text: Yes! I want to try the street food there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Me too. I also need a bag for my mom.

dialogue.speaker: Becky
dialogue.text: Good. There are lots of bags and clothes there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: What time does it open?

dialogue.speaker: Becky
dialogue.text: At five. But it's very hot before seven.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then let's go at seven. We can eat first and shop after.

dialogue.speaker: Becky
dialogue.text: Good plan. Bring cash. Many sellers don't take cards.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Let's meet at the bus stop at six thirty.

titleTh: เตรียมตัวไปเรียนวาดรูป
scenarioSentences: Your first class is on Wednesday.
Mr. Gill is the art teacher.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Gill. What do I need for Wednesday's class?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Gill
dialogue.text: Not much. We have paint, brushes and paper for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Great. What are we going to paint?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Gill
dialogue.text: Flowers. I'll bring some from my garden.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I'm not very good at art.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Gill
dialogue.text: Don't worry. It's a class for beginners.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Do I need special clothes?

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Gill
dialogue.text: Yes, bring an old shirt. Paint can get on your clothes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. I'll bring my dad's old shirt.

dialogue.speaker: Mr. Gill
dialogue.text: Good idea. See you on Wednesday at four.

titleEn: Waiting for a friend who is late
titleTh: รอเพื่อนที่มาสาย
scenarioSentences: You are meeting your friend Josh.
You are at the station at noon.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi, Josh. I'm at the station. Where are you?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: I'm so sorry! I missed my bus.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oh no. When is the next one?

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: In fifteen minutes. So I'll be there at about twelve thirty.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's very cold here. I don't want to stand outside.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: There's a small café next to the station. Wait there.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good idea. I'll get a hot drink.

dialogue.speaker: Josh
dialogue.text: Great. I'll buy lunch for you to say sorry.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Ha, okay! See you in the café.

titleTh: ดูแลน้องสาวตอนแม่ไม่อยู่บ้าน
scenarioSentences: Your mom is going out tonight.
You will look after your sister.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mom, what do I need to do tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: First, give your sister dinner at six. It's in the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Okay. Do I just heat it up?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Yes, five minutes in the microwave.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Can she watch TV after dinner?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: Yes, for one hour. Then a bath at seven thirty.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: And what time does she go to bed?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: At eight. Please read her a short story first.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: No problem. When are you coming home?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.text: At about eleven. You can call me anytime.

titleEn: Buying a board game for a cousin
titleTh: ซื้อเกมเป็นของขวัญให้ลูกพี่ลูกน้อง
scenarioSentences: Your cousin's birthday is next week.
You want to buy him a game.
You go to a toy store.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hi. I'm looking for a game for my cousin. He's turning eight.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Nice. Does he like board games?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, but long games are boring for him.

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Then this card game is great. It takes only fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is it easy to learn?

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Very easy. The rules are on one small card.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: How many people can play?

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Two to six players. It's good for families.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll take it. How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Ollie
dialogue.text: Twelve dollars. Do you want a gift bag?
